Several weeks (depends on the points you earn from Weekly Tasks)

The {wiki:Falconer Outfits|Falconer Outfit} and its two addons are not earned from NPCs: you buy each piece in the Hunting Task Shop of the {wiki:Task Board} with Hunting Task Points, which you accumulate by completing Weekly Tasks. The full outfit costs 170,000 points and gives the achievement Falconer.
Access to the {wiki:Task Board} and Weekly Tasks.
Falconer Outfit first and second addons
Hunting Task Points are earned by completing the Weekly Tasks on the Task Board. Save up the points and spend them at the {wiki:Task Board|Hunting Task Shop} once you have enough for each piece.
Complete Weekly Tasks on the {wiki:Task Board} to accumulate **Hunting Task Points**. You need 170,000 points for the full outfit.
2. Buying the outfit at the Hunting Task Shop
Once you have **100,000** Hunting Task Points, open the Task Board, go to the **Hunting Task Shop** and buy the base Falconer outfit.
Collect another **35,000** Hunting Task Points, open the Task Board, go to the Hunting Task Shop and buy the first Falconer addon.
